treatment.schedule_summary: Doxorubicin 25 mg/m² IV push on Days 1–3 plus cisplatin 100 mg/m² IV in 1000 mL sodium chloride 0.9% over 2 hours on Day 1. Six 21-day cycles, usually three before and three after surgery following pathology review.

reference_planned_totals.meaning: Arithmetic of six full reference courses; not guaranteed delivery. Only doxorubicin has the stated lifetime ceiling.
